objective: Predictively compare the exact DESI DR2 BAO-selected flat-LCDM and interacting-vacuum shapes on DES-Dovekie SNe, conditioning on training redshift blocks and analytically integrating only the shared magnitude intercept.
command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/run_bounded.py --seconds 1200 -- .venv/bin/python experiments/dovekie_frozen_shape_cv/conditional_cv.py

independent_review.method: Independent SNANA parser, dense covariance-domain conditioning, independent ODE/quadrature; no production scoring import and no refit.

likelihood_contract.dataset: Pinned DES-Dovekie SNANA release, one 1820-row SN branch, exact order, full STAT+SYS precision.
likelihood_contract.redshift_partition: 4 equal-count contiguous zHD groups over unique z values, ties unsplit; edges [0.32433, 0.479345, 0.626935].
likelihood_contract.edge_robustness: Six predeclared variants, each moving one internal quartile cumulative target by +/-1% of N, other targets fixed; range in IVS-minus-LCDM integrated conditional -2log predictive score [-4.11795446, -3.04856881].
likelihood_contract.nuisance: One common additive magnitude offset; training-only GLS estimate and flat-prior posterior integrated into the predictive covariance with its rank-one variance term.
likelihood_contract.probe_cross_covariance: Not released; probes are reported separately and no statistical independence is claimed.

finding.interpretation: Modest, edge-stable descriptive prediction advantage for the BAO-frozen IVS point, driven by the lowest-z fold; other three folds slightly favor LCDM. Overlapping holdout sums are not an additive joint likelihood, significance, posterior, or evidence. Mixed with prior BAO-block CV, which strongly penalized IVS at z=2.33.

artifacts.plot_command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/run_bounded.py --seconds 30 -- .venv/bin/python experiments/dovekie_frozen_shape_cv/plot_result.py

stop_disposition: Continue with a separately reported Dovekie-only two-parameter background profile after the no-score model-domain contract is reviewed. Keep BAO and SN likelihoods separate; do not interpret a profile gain as evidence.
